name: website-copilot
description: Repo-wide checks for the website copilot. Each package keeps its own scripts.

scripts.test: npm --prefix copilot-engine test && node --test eval/tests/*.test.ts && node --no-warnings --test demo/live-site/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:py && npm run typecheck && npm run orphans && npm test && npm run scenarios
